feature: Admin E2-D: a show's venue on Event edit (the picker, the crawled read-only state, the Moved pill and line) and Add a show's shared venue list
note: CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin. Boards: design/design_handoff_admin_redesign 06-events-artists-prices/event-edit and event-edit-mobile (Venue field, Status pills, the Moved line); addendum 5 04-event-edit/venue-picker-d and venue-picker-m (the open list). Replace MANUAL_SHOW_ID with a manual upcoming scratch show with NO Watchers, CRAWLED_SHOW_ID with a crawled upcoming show, and MOVED_SHOW_ID with a manual show already moved once (a 'moved' redirect off another venue). Rows never press Save, so they write nothing; the moved row needs a real move done beforehand. By hand: the move confirm (shown only when the show has Watchers, which comes from the server-side GET, so a route stub can't reach it; it reuses the Postponed/Hide confirm), the refusal toasts (duplicate show with Open it, crawled race, venue gone) and the partial-save toast, all covered by EventEdit.test.
